sloka: क्रोधमूर्च्छितरूपस्तु धून्वन् परमकार्मुकम् ।दृष्ट्वा तु कर्म शत्रूणां सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५६.२ ।।।।
transliteration: krodhamūrcchitarūpastu dhūnvan paramakārmukam ।dṛṣṭvā tu karma śatrūṇāṁ sārathiṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 6.56.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Looking at the deeds of enemies, deluded with violent anger, Akampana spoke these words holding the bow and looking at the charioteer.
